name: jpegxs-web
description: JPEG XS encoder and decoder for the browser and node (SVT-JPEG-XS compiled to WebAssembly)

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:threads && npm run build:wasm:single
scripts.build:wasm:threads: emcmake cmake -S . -B build/lib -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && ninja -C build/lib
scripts.build:wasm:single: emcmake cmake -S . -B build/lib-st -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DJXS_THREADS=OFF && ninja -C build/lib-st
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
